profile_text.body:
GE HealthCare Technologies Inc. is a publicly traded company (ticker GEHC) headquartered in Chicago, Illinois, and files with the SEC under CIK 0001932393. Its website describes it as a provider of digital infrastructure, data analytics, and decision support tools used in the diagnosis, treatment, and monitoring of patients. The company says it builds integrated solutions aimed at what it calls the industry's greatest challenges, and describes its view of the future of healthcare as precise, personal, and connected.

On AI, the site states that the company has over 130 years of delivering innovative solutions and that it tops the FDA's list of AI-enabled medical devices. It says these tools help hospitals and healthcare systems transform their operations and help clinicians make therapies more accurate and effective. No specific AI products are named in the material available.

The company's litigation exposure is recorded as concentrated in Illinois, with 374 cases there. No lawsuits are listed against it in the cases record, and no MCP servers are associated with it.
